We were supposed to reach Chikmagalur before dark.
We didn't.

The car stopped.
No network.
No calls.
Nothing.
I kept checking my phone anyway.

Then I remembered I'd saved NakshIQ.
Emergency numbers.
Offline.

I walked up the road until one bar came back.
Made the call.

And that's when I understood...
A travel guide tells you where to go.
Travel intelligence tells you what to do when things go wrong.
NakshIQ.
